rules.description: Ensures all SAHIE StatVars share the same latest observation year.
Verifies that all StatVars meet freshness requirements within the Census SAHIE publication lag (up to 3 years in early calendar months before the annual release).

params.condition: MaxDate IS NOT NULL AND CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INT) >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 3
